title: El Trueno · La laguna y las varas
variant: Martín Kuskue, primer relato, Bernal 1953 / Villa Posse 1993, PDF p.65, impresa 55

entrada.role: selected triptych: P01 and C01 identities, paper landscape

acto.role: selected triptych: two C02 authorities, dry shoreline, night water

generation.continuity: Each frame from third uses last TWO visually accepted frames plus necessary canonical identities. Rejected versions excluded.

common_prompt: Create ONE finished cinematic vertical 9:16 narrative keyframe for the Nasa–Paeces film El Trueno, ideally 864x1536. No sheet, collage, border, lettering, title, captions, watermark or logo. Use the supplied images only for their stated continuity roles, never copy their sheet layout. Same world as the approved Nasa triptych: immersive Colombian highland CUT-PAPER scenery, matte broad flat faces, internal cut edges, folded rock, overlapping planes at three distances, physical occlusion and cast shadows. Figures have simplified almost-flat paper faces, not rounded clay dolls, CGI or photographic skin. Water, clouds and mist are flat cut-paper shapes too, never cotton or smoke. Frame extends edge to edge, no display base, table, studio or diorama box. Preserve precise age, clothing, hat, material and scale of the reference identities. Do not import objects, people or actions from preceding shots unless specifically listed below. No pan-Indigenous costumes, copied sacred patterns, gold, crowns, feathers, magical beams or invented ritual. Selected narrative: Martín Kuskue's first El Trueno account via Bernal 1953; the elder appearance is a declared editorial convention retained from the approved triptych, not claimed as wording of this version.

blocks.voice_over: Iban de noche a hablar con el Trueno. Pero no todos podían acercarse a él y seguir vivos.
blocks.purpose: Abrir con una acción y un riesgo; resolver por qué se acercan en B5.

keyframes.title: La mano y la vara
keyframes.camera: detalle lateral a altura de cintura
keyframes.visual: Night at the lagoon approach. CLOSE DETAIL of the green-shawl woman's one hand firmly holding ONE plain straight dark chonta staff upright, fingers as simple layered paper. Only her clothed forearm, a small fold of green shawl and the staff enter left foreground. The staff continues below the frame, its tip not visible. Far behind, a narrow deep-indigo highland lagoon and folded dark ridges remain recognizable. No water contact yet, no ripples, no lightning, no other hand or staff. Her face and other people stay outside frame. Suspense through scale and stillness, not glowing magic.

keyframes.title: Dos figuras en la noche
keyframes.visual: WIDE HIGH OBLIQUE establishing view. Exactly TWO small full-body authorities, the green-shawl woman and blue-gray ruana man from acto/C02, walk along the dry left shore path toward the small dark lagoon in middle distance. Each carries ONE plain straight staff; exactly two staffs total. Woman leads left-to-right, man follows. Their feet are on ochre paper land, the water is clearly separated to their right. The two figures are less than one sixth of frame height. Tall near rock silhouette at left foreground, path and figures midground, confined lagoon and successive ridges background. No visible Trueno.

blocks.voice_over: En Calderas se contaba que había defendido aquellas tierras. Desde una peña lanzó su boleadora y venció a sus adversarios.
blocks.purpose: Retroceso explícito: causa de su autoridad; violencia fuera de campo.

keyframes.title: La piedra alta
keyframes.visual: FLASHBACK in cold overcast DAYLIGHT. Low-angle wide shot of ONE elderly Trueno on the tall rocky ridge, his full body small but readable, tan broad plain hat, short gray hair, black broad cape, charcoal garments and black shoes identical to P01/entrada. His arm has just released ONE compact ordinary paper boleadora outward into empty sky, far to right, a simple small cord and weight. This is a single frozen gesture, no motion trail or duplicated limbs. No other people, no targets or bodies. Large foreground folded cliff, figure on ledge midground, storm-paper sky and distant ridges background. No staff, no serpent, no gold, no magic beam.

keyframes.title: El territorio después del golpe
keyframes.visual: FLASHBACK daylight, a NEW high distant view down the narrow paper mountain valleys following the previous throw. Landscape alone: ochre slopes, olive terraces, blue-green ridges, storm-gray clouds, one small restrained pale paper lightning cut far in the background. A break between broad cloud sheets lets a narrow area of land become readable. Violence stays entirely offscreen. No people, bodies, animals, weapon, houses, fire or aftermath props. Continuous immersive terrain, not a map. This is a spatial consequence cut, not a new supernatural event.

blocks.voice_over: Después avisó a los médicos: el peligro había pasado. Ya podían abrir terreno para cultivar. Entonces se retiró a Vichaguau.
blocks.purpose: La fuerza se convierte en permiso; salida con destino claro.

keyframes.title: El aviso
keyframes.visual: DAYLIGHT on the ridge, medium-wide GROUP shot, a different intimate camera from the triptych. Exactly THREE fully clothed adults: P01 Trueno upper right on modest natural ledge, and the C01 leftmost older man and blue-shawl woman lower left listening, identical to entrada. Trueno has one relaxed open advising hand, no weapon or staff. The C01 man has ONE plain staff and a modest fiber bag; blue-shawl woman has bag, no staff. Bodies occupy about one third frame height, faces made of flat layered paper. Foreground side of rock, three people in middle plane, very distant cultivated slopes beyond. No mouth speech posing, no new magic.

keyframes.title: El retiro
keyframes.visual: DAYLIGHT fading to blue-gray dusk. ONE elderly Trueno seen from behind walking away along a narrow dry ridge toward a SMALL highland lagoon far ahead. Exact black cape broad angular silhouette, tan hat and gray hair from P01. His two empty hands; no staff, no bag, no weapon. He is entirely on the path, not sinking, not vanishing or transforming. The cape edge has the same broad paper rhythm as cloud layers without physically becoming a cloud. Foreground ochre path enters lower left and leads to figure then lagoon; close dark paper cliffs at either side and far mist strata.

blocks.voice_over: El Trueno se había ido a una laguna. Los antiguos cabildos seguían buscándolo allí, caminando de noche con sus varas de mando.
blocks.purpose: Volver a la noche del inicio y hacer legible el destino.

keyframes.title: Vichaguau
keyframes.visual: NIGHT, high oblique bird's-eye view of the SMALL enclosed Vichaguau lagoon, same paper mountain language as acto. A narrow ochre shoreline surrounds dark indigo paper water. Three depths: near dark crag silhouette, middle water basin, far folded ridges and thin white flat paper mist strips. No people, no staffs, no spirit under water, no giant face, no buildings, no ripples yet. This landscape establishes the destination, never a verified geographic map. Rich paper depth, water calm.

keyframes.title: La subida de los cabildos
keyframes.visual: NIGHT. Side-on low wide shot, exactly the SAME two authorities: green-shawl woman leading on the right and blue-gray ruana older man following on the left, walking left-to-right across dry ochre paper path. One plain staff each, exactly two in total. Entire feet visible planted on ground. Their silhouettes pass between a close folded rock and the confined dark lagoon in distance. No Trueno, no hats added, no torches. Humans one quarter of frame height. Use cliff occlusion and three layered distances; not a repeat of the aerial shot.

blocks.voice_over: Al llegar, las enfriaban en el agua. Pedían su ayuda y sus remedios para que muriera menos gente.
blocks.purpose: Responder al gancho con una necesidad humana concreta, sin fabricar remedios.

keyframes.title: Enfriar las varas
keyframes.visual: NIGHT. Medium-wide side view of SAME green-shawl woman and blue-gray ruana man, on the dry near-left shore. Exactly TWO fully clothed adults, all four feet clearly on ochre dry land well behind the water boundary. Each holds ONE plain continuous dark staff with both hands, slanted forward; both staff tips visibly touch the near lagoon surface. Exactly TWO staff contact points with two small dark-blue PAPER ripple rings. Woman slightly ahead, man just behind; no interlocked arms. Both full bodies visible. Paper plants foreground, two people and tips middle ground, small confined lagoon and distant ridges background. No Trueno visible, glow, portal, ceremonial diagrams, medicines or offerings.

keyframes.title: La petición
keyframes.visual: NIGHT. CLOSE OVERHEAD detail at the SAME near shoreline, ONLY the bottom ends of TWO straight plain dark chonta staffs entering the water diagonally from upper-left beyond the frame. Exactly two intact rods and two contact points. Their two small concentric ripple groups are cut from broad matte blue paper layers, gently overlapping in center. An ochre folded-paper shore wedge remains at top left, deep indigo water fills rest of frame. No hands, people, reflections of faces, magical glows, droplets, ritual signs, letters or medicinal objects. One quiet physical contact made legible through separated paper planes and shadows.

blocks.voice_over: Tiempo después, otros médicos dejaron de ir. Decían que no estaban preparados. Una fuerza capaz de sostenerlos también podía matarlos.
blocks.purpose: El límite final cambia la relación con el mismo lugar; no añadir castigo.

keyframes.title: Los que ya no van
keyframes.visual: LATER TIME, muted blue-gray late dusk. Two anonymous medical elders from C01, the older gray/olive-clothed man with tan hat and blue-shawl woman, stand STILL on a dry ridge path before the descent. Rear three-quarter medium shot, upper bodies to knees, the woman half-turns slightly toward the man, both looking at a distant lagoon. They are NOT the C02 pair in the earlier pilgrimage. Plain modest fiber bags, the man has ONE plain staff resting firmly on ground, woman none. Their posture expresses hesitation, not collapse or worship. Folded ochre rock foreground, two adults middle, lagoon tiny behind two ridges. No visible Trueno, supernatural threat or performing ritual.

keyframes.title: El camino vacío
keyframes.camera: general frontal a ras del sendero
keyframes.visual: LATER dusk. Camera low on an EMPTY narrow ochre mountain footpath heading toward the distant confined lagoon. The path turns out of sight behind a high rock. No people at all, no abandoned staffs, no graves, no storm attack, no blocked magic barrier. One broad dark-gray paper cloud layer hangs over the distant water; white mist is sharply cut flat paper. Foreground tactile cliff and small paper highland plants, middle path, far water and mountains. The absence is the change, not a new disaster.

blocks.voice_over: La laguna seguía allí. Lo que ya no estaba al alcance de todos era saber cómo acercarse.
blocks.purpose: Cierre editorial: volver al agua con otra relación, sin moraleja añadida.

keyframes.title: La laguna permanece
keyframes.visual: BLUE NIGHT. A contemplative distant view from the SAME dry near shore into Vichaguau. Empty ochre shoreline lower left where the two authorities formerly stood, small still indigo lagoon between close dark folded ridges, restrained white paper mist. No people, no staffs, no footprints, no objects left behind, no spirit emerging. Multiple rich paper layers with air and shadows, borderless immersive world. The scene is calm yet powerful; unchanged water after the human relationship has changed.

keyframes.title: Agua sin varas
keyframes.visual: FINAL bookend, same overhead camera and same shore wedge as b5b, but BOTH STAFFS ARE ABSENT. Only an ochre cut-paper shore wedge at top left and layered matte dark-indigo water filling the frame. The previous circular contact ripples have settled into broad quiet irregular blue paper sheets. Near sheet edges cast subtle shallow shadows onto farther layers. No object, person, hand, face, text, glow, symbol or new magical event. Tactile, cinematic, restrained, frame filled completely with the physical paper water surface.
